summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules, reporting a series of share repurchases of Class A ordinary shares (represented by ADSs) on May 20–June 1, 2026. Repurchases totaled 1,683,881 shares at prices ranging from USD 22.12 to USD 22.86 per ADS, aggregating approximately $38.3 million. The repurchases have not yet been cancelled, reflecting shares bought for treasury but pending cancellation. The filing confirms ongoing execution of ZTO's buyback program, likely under a previously announced authorization. What to watch: continued execution pace and potential for cancellation, which would reduce share count.
